How to Use the Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026 on Your Phone

A step-by-step phone guide — search, filter, directions, saving pandals, building a route and staying online in crowds.

The Durga Puja pandal map 2026 is built for phones first. You do not need an app — open it in any browser. Here is how to get the most out of it in a few minutes.

Works on
Any phone browser
Time to learn
About a minute
Saved pandals
Stored on your phone
Offline backup
Google Maps offline area

Step by step

  1. Open the map. Go to the Siliguri Puja map. All 83 pandals appear as numbered pins showing their score.
  2. Search. Type a pandal name, area or theme — for example “Hakimpara” or “terracotta”.
  3. Filter. Pick a neighbourhood from the area menu, or tap Top Theme, Traditional, Parking or Verified.
  4. Tap a pin. See the theme, visit time and parking status, then open the full pandal page.
  5. Get directions. Tap Directions to open Google Maps with the pandal as your destination.
  6. Save it. Tap the bookmark icon. Your list appears under Saved and stays on your phone.
  7. Build a route. Use the route planner to order several pandals from your start point.

Using “Near me”

Tap Near Me in the header and allow location access. The planner can then start your route from where you are standing, and Google Maps opens straight into navigation from your live GPS position.

Staying connected in big crowds

  • Mobile data often slows near the biggest pandals. Save your pandals before you leave home.
  • In Google Maps, download Siliguri as an offline area so turn-by-turn directions still work.
  • Take a screenshot of your route timeline as a backup.
  • Keep a power bank — maps and cameras drain batteries quickly on Pujo nights.

Share your plan with family

After building a route, tap Share Route to send the list of pandals and the Google Maps link on WhatsApp. Everyone in the group can then follow the same order.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to install an app for the Durga Puja pandal map 2026?

No. The map runs in any phone browser. You can add it to your home screen from the browser menu for quicker access.

Where are my saved pandals stored?

Saved pandals are stored privately on your own phone in the browser. They are not uploaded anywhere.

Why does the map ask for my location?

Only to show pandals near you and to start routes from your position. It works fine without location access — just pick a starting point instead.

Can I share a pandal route on WhatsApp?

Yes. Use Share Route after building a route to send the pandal list and Google Maps link.
